scope: 视觉设计稿，未修改 App 实现。原生导航与 Tab 样式，任务卡按可用宽度统一双列或单列；图中为不同滚动位置的手机视口。
prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Input image is an aesthetic and feature reference for the existing 多多打卡 panda space habit app. Create a REVISED PROFESSIONAL IPHONE UI DESIGN BOARD that fixes the reference's unrealistic compressed layout and inconsistent full-width versus half-width task tiles. This is a new design artifact, not an implementation screenshot.

OUTPUT: ONE high resolution LANDSCAPE image approximately 3:2, containing THREE clean front-facing iPhone UI viewport mockups side by side on a quiet pale gray presentation background. Each viewport is a real tall phone proportion (roughly 393 by 852 points for first two, 375 by 812 points for third), with its own complete status bar, navigation bar, scroll content, bottom tab bar and home indicator. No perspective, no tilt, no hands, no thick phone hardware. Outside each viewport, above it, a small editorial caption respectively “首页 · 双列”, “任务区 · 双列”, “窄屏适配 · 单列”. The viewport scale must be large enough to read clear Chinese. Do NOT create another extremely compressed full-page poster, and do NOT cram all 17 tasks into a single phone viewport. These are scrolled views of the same longer homepage.

CRITICAL IOS DESIGN:
Use a faithful standard native iOS navigation bar: centered title “多多打卡”, plain SF Symbols info.circle leading button and lock.shield trailing button, subdued translucent system material, appropriate safe area and 44pt navigation height. No illustrated navigation, no giant bubble circles, no custom game HUD in the navigation.
Use a faithful standard native iOS bottom TabView/UITabBar with three SF Symbols icons and labels exactly “今日打卡”, “打卡统计”, “积分消耗”. First selected, other two neutral gray; native material background and home indicator safe area. No toy buttons, spaceship decorations, or custom capsule segmented selector masquerading as tab bar. Native iOS typography hierarchy and alignment. Rounded SF-like Chinese system font, primary near-black text, 17pt task titles, 13pt detail text, clear 44pt minimum action buttons.
16pt horizontal content margin, 12pt grid gap, 24pt between sections, 12pt card interior padding, 16pt consistent corner radius, gentle shadow at most. Everything visibly implementable in SwiftUI.

GRID RULE IS NONNEGOTIABLE:
In both first and second viewports, ALL TASK CARDS are the same HALF-WIDTH of a strictly uniform TWO-COLUMN grid. Every card same standard height within rows. If a section has an odd task count, its last card stays HALF-WIDTH aligned left with empty space to its right. Never stretch an odd card to full width. Overview/summary panels may be full width because they are NOT task cards.
In the third viewport, ALL TASK CARDS are full width in a consistent ONE-COLUMN list for compact screens. Each is a spacious horizontal composition, illustration left, name/time in center, accessible action to right/bottom, no mixed columns. These are responsive variants, not a user-facing layout setting.

ART DIRECTION:
Keep the friendly baby panda astronaut and soft clay space toys from reference, but reduce decoration by about 65 percent. Light grouped-system-background ivory/lavender, crisp white/lightly tinted cards. A delightful panda and little rocket in the top hero, small friendly illustrated task icons, tiny star rewards and subtle approval stamp. NO massive sculpted frames around whole sections, no castles covering headers, no starry wallpaper behind paragraphs, no clutter behind native chrome. Playful content, calm native shell. For a six-year-old: obvious imagery, large action affordances, positive progress and joyful earned stars. Main section colors exactly energy #FF8D28, knowledge #B0A0FF, life #00D2E0, courage #FF375F. Use these for accents and buttons with dark readable labels, not pale low-contrast title text. Section headings dark text with small colored marker and progress pill.

VIEWPORT 1: 首页 · 双列
Native top bar.
Compact cheerful header “今天也要闪闪发光！”.
A full-width well-proportioned hero card, about 230pt tall: panda astronaut and small rocket at right, prominent “6 / 13” effective daily progress with rocket-fuel meter at left. Short “再得7分，飞船就能出发啦！”. Three small neatly aligned counters “今日自评 7”, “有效打卡 6”, “奖励分 0”. Small native-looking “家长确认” action.
Separate slim full-width exploration summary: “我的星际旅程”, “本月 6 / 50”, mini solar-system nodes or small rocket, native chevron. Secondary label “每50分解锁星球”.
Then “能量补给站” with progress “2 / 5”. ONE ROW of TWO roomy same-size task cards: “起床” +1 with sun/bed clay icon, time “07:12”, “已完成”, tiny translucent approval check stamp; “吃早饭” +1 with meal clay icon, stopwatch icon “25:11/30”, “已完成”, approval stamp. Keep enough room for the native tab bar; lower rows continue below the fold, not squeezed into view.

VIEWPORT 2: 任务区 · 双列
Same native top bar and bottom tab bar, same phone width and grid metrics as viewport 1. This is scrolled further down.
“知识探索站” progress “1 / 3”.
First row two equal task cards: “认真听讲” +2, headphones/books illustration, “已完成” and subtle stamp; “写作业” +2, pencil notebook, active timer icon plus “12:36”, clear “结束” button.
Second row only LEFT half-width card: “阅读” +2, illustrated book, “至少15分钟”, “开始” button. Right half remains empty breathing space, DO NOT turn reading into a full-width row.
Then “生活空间站” with progress “3 / 5”, first row two same-size cards: “收拾玩具” +1, tidy toy basket, “已完成”; “打扫卫生” +1, broom, “打卡”. Show only content fitting comfortably in the phone viewport. Keep text entirely inside cards, unobscured by artwork or stamp. These two rows plus the next section should feel like real scroll content.

VIEWPORT 3: 窄屏适配 · 单列
Slightly narrower native phone viewport, same iOS navigation and tabs. Scrolled to “勇气成长站”, progress “0 / 4”. ALL task cards are FULL-WIDTH, consistently one per row:
“乖巧听话” +2, small friendly heart/panda illustration, “打卡” button.
“不发脾气” +2, calm panda and leaf, “打卡” button.
“做事不拖拉” +2, lightning illustration, short “三餐、作业后解锁”, subdued “尚未解锁” and lock icon.
“诚实守信” +1, shield/check illustration, “打卡” button.
Four spacious horizontal cards can fit within one scroll viewport with native controls and normal type. Preserve the requested pink section accent.

Preserve point meanings, 13 point daily goal, timers and parent confirmation. No extra tab, accounts, currency, leaderboard, shop or invented game mechanic. No huge ornament border. No section color as full-screen fill. Main goal: an attractive child-friendly game-like app that is unmistakably a real native iPhone app and whose card layouts are consistent at each width. Text must be crisp Simplified Chinese; do not add stray English headings or implementation code.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this three-iPhone design board with only small correctness fixes in the CENTER phone. Preserve the three-phone composition, native iOS status/navigation/tab bars, screen proportions, all existing illustrations, type sizes, spacing, and left and right phones unchanged.
CENTER PHONE:
1. Completely REMOVE the dashed empty tile to the right of 阅读, including plus sign and “更多任务 敬请期待”. Leave that entire half-column empty, using exactly the existing subtle knowledge-section background. This is intentional breathing room for an odd count in a two-column grid, NOT a placeholder or add-task control.
2. REMOVE ONLY the faint mint approval stamp from the upper-right of the 阅读 card. Reading is unstarted and its 开始 button must remain.
3. At the very bottom of the center scrolling content just above the native tab bar, REMOVE the prematurely shown pink 勇气成长站 / 0/4 header. In its place show just the very top edges of the next ROW of TWO cyan-themed life-section cards as they continue below the fold: the task labels “洗漱” on the left and “干净卫生” on the right, with their +1 point tokens. This row is mostly below the viewport and occluded naturally by the native tab bar; do not squeeze in more cards, do not change any card heights or reduce font sizes. The life section has more tasks continuing below.
Do not add anything else. Output the full three-viewport board at same aspect ratio and quality.
